# daily.place

> Create your perfect space to focus on your daily tasks.

daily.place is a free focus app. Each place lives at its own URL (`https://daily.place/<name>`) and combines:

- A pomodoro timer with focus, short break and long break modes
- A to-do list
- Ambient sounds to play while you work
- Optional sign-in to sync places and tasks across devices

The app is available in English, Spanish and Portuguese. Data is stored in the browser unless you sign in.

## Links

- [Home](https://daily.place/): create a place
- [Changelog](https://daily.place/changelog): release notes
- [Contact](https://daily.place/contact): feedback and bug reports
